paite: Huchi in Boaz kulh kongpi ah ahohtou a, huai ah atu hi. Ngai in, atanau bul uh atungtang thu Boaz in agen ahong pai hi. Huai mi kiang ah, "Eh! Nang na hi maw! Hong pai inla, hong tu dih ve," achi hi. Amah hong pai in atuta hi.
heading: Boaz In Ruth Akitenpih

paite: Huai khua a upate lak a mi sawm api a, akiang uah, "Hiai ah tu dih ua," achi a, huchi in amau atuta uhi.
Atanau bul uh kiang ah, "Moab gam a pan hong kik Naomi in i unaupa Elimelek gam azuak hi.

Huchi in khomite mitmuh leh ka mite upate mitmuh in lei in. Na tat nopleh tan in. Himahleh na tatnop keileh ka theihtheihna ding in hon hilh in. Nang lou lah kuamah atan dia kilawm a-om ngal kei ua. Nang zom in kei ka hi chih nang hon theihsak kiphamoh in ka thei,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka tan ding," achi hi.
Boaz in, "Naomi khut a pan huai gam na lei ni'n, misi zi, Moab numei Ruth a pan misi min bei lou a, agouluah ding mi a-om zel theihna ding in na lei tel ding ahi," achi hi.
Atanau bulpa in, "Kei a ding in zaw ka tan thei kei. Huchi lou in zaw keimah gouluah ka mansuah kha ding. Ka tattheihna nang tang mai in. Ke'n zaw tan thei lou ka himai hi,” achi hi.
Nidanglai a Israelte lak a thil bangkim ahihkipna ding ua akitatdan uleh akikhendan uh hichi ahi. Khedap aphel ua, avengte uh apia ua, huai Israelte lak a ahihdan uh ahi.
Huchi in atanau bulpa un Boaz kiang ah, "Nang a ding in lei zaw in," achi hi. Huchi in akhedap aphelta hi.
Boaz in upate leh mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Tuni in noute Elimelek thil neih tengteng leh Kilon leh Mahlon thil neih tengteng Naomi khut a pan ka lei chih theihpihtute na hi uh.
Huai kia hilou in misi min amanlouhna ding in Moab numei Ruth, Mahlon zi ka zi ding in ka lei a, huai, tuni in noute atheihpihtute na hi uh," achi hi.

Kulh kongpi a mipi tengteng leh upate'n, "Theihpihtute ka hi uh. Na inn a numei hong lut Rakil leh Leah, Israel inkuan dingsak nihte bang in TOUPA'N bawl hen. Nang Ephrathah ah suanhuaitak in hong om inla, Bethlehem ah minthangtak in hong om in.
TOUPA'N hiai nungaknou a pan suan ahon bawlsak ding ziak in na inkuan uh Tamar in Judah asuansak Perez inkuan bang hong hi hen," achi uhi.
Huchi in Boaz in Ruth api a, azi ahong hita hi. Huchi in akithuahpih a, TOUPA'N nau apaisak a, tapa anei hi.
heading: Boaz Leh Asuante

paite: Numeite'n Naomi kiang ah, "Tuni mahmah a tanau nai bei a hon omsak lou, TOUPA phat in om hen. Israelte lak ah amin hong thang hen.
Amah na hinna tungdingpa leh na tek lam a hon vakpa ahong hi dia; na mounu nang hon itnu, tapa sagihte sang a nang a dia hoih in amah lah asuangta ngal a," achi uhi.
Naomi in nau ala a, apom a, adonta hi.
A-inveng numeite'n amin aphuak ua, "Naomi a ding in tapa ahong piangta," chi in amin Obed asa uhi. Amah, David pa Jesse pa ahi.
Hiaite Perez suante ahi uh. Perez in Hezron asuang;
Hezron in Ram asuang; Ram in Amminadab asuang;
Amminadab in Nashon asuang a, Nashon in Salmon asuang;
Salmon in Boaz asuang a, Boaz in Obed asuang;
Obed in Jesse asuang a, Jesse in David asuang hi.
